standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source line 1113)

standard_prerequisites.name: The Noetherianity of the completion of a Noetherian local ring
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 1115-1116)
standard_prerequisites.use: Stops the ascending chain of hom modules.

standard_prerequisites.name: The description of the hull as the union of the submodules killed by the powers of the maximal ideal
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 1119-1121)
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides a nonzero element annihilated by the maximal ideal in any nonzero quotient.

core_obligations: Build a chain of hom modules: a descending chain of submodules gives a chain of restrictions that are surjections, each carrying a module structure over the endomorphism ring of the hull, which is the Noetherian completion (proof lines 1109-1116)
Stabilize: Noetherianity of that ring forces the chain of hom modules to become constant (proof lines 1115-1117)

Contradict a proper inclusion: constancy forces the hom module of the quotient of two consecutive members to vanish; but a nonzero quotient contains a nonzero element killed by the maximal ideal because the hull is power torsion, and such an element produces a nonzero map into the hull, a contradiction (proof lines 1117-1123)
proof_roadmap: 取 E ⊃ M_1 ⊃ M_2 ⊃ …；由限制得 Hom_R(E,E) → Hom_R(M_1,E) → … 一串满射。
由 endos 引理 Hom_R(E,E) = R^ 是完备化、Noetherian ⇒ 该链稳定。
稳定 ⇒ Hom_R(M_n/M_{n+1}, E) = 0；若商非零，则由 E 是 m-幂挠（union-artinian）它含被 m 杀死的非零元，从而有非零映射入 E，矛盾 ⇒ E 满足降链条件。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement says that an injective hull of the residue field of a Noetherian local ring satisfies the descending chain condition (author lemma at source lines 1101-1106, label lemma-injective-hull-has-dcc). The proof (source lines 1108-1124) turns a descending chain of submodules into a chain of restriction surjections of hom modules into the hull, uses that the endomorphism ring of the hull is the Noetherian completion to stop that chain, and rules out a proper inclusion by exhibiting a nonzero element killed by the maximal ideal in the quotient, which would give a nonzero map into the hull (proof lines 1117-1123). The stabilization and the final contradiction are the substance. H3.
